dataset.description: Description: This dataset/description covers the initial research outputs generated during the early stage of the postdoctoral project, including literature review materials, bibliographic records, analytical notes, a scientific article draft or submitted manuscript, a scientific poster and a project presentation. These materials support the development of the project’s theoretical and methodological basis for chaos-based secure data transmission in UAV-assisted power grid inspection and digital twin-related infrastructure monitoring. At this stage, no experimental RGB/LiDAR transmission dataset has yet been generated. Simulation data, processed image transmission results and restricted industrial validation data are planned for later stages of the project and will be added to the Data Management Plan as separate dataset descriptions when available.

distribution.title:
The purpose of this dataset is to document, preserve and organise the initial research outputs generated during the early stage of the postdoctoral project. These outputs include literature review materials, bibliographic records, analytical notes, a scientific article draft or submitted manuscript, a scientific poster and a project presentation. The dataset supports the development of the theoretical and methodological basis for the project, which focuses on chaos-based secure data transmission for UAV-assisted power grid inspection and cyber-physical security in energy networks.

At this stage, no experimental RGB/LiDAR transmission dataset or simulation dataset has yet been generated. Experimental, simulation and validation data are planned for later work packages and will be added to the Data Management Plan as separate dataset descriptions when they become available.

dataset.title: Literature Review, Publication and Dissemination Materials on Chaos-Secured Power Grid Inspection Data Transmission

dmp.description:
This Data Management Plan describes the management, documentation, storage, access, preservation and re-use of research data generated and processed within the postdoctoral research project “Chaos-Based Data Transmission for Power Grid Inspection: Enhancing Cyber-Physical Security in Energy Networks”. The project will use and generate several categories of research outputs, including UAV-based RGB and LiDAR inspection data, synthetic and benchmark image data, MATLAB-based chaos modulation models, simulation code, encrypted and decrypted image transmission outputs, performance evaluation metrics, digital twin integration documentation, technical reports and publication-related datasets.

The DMP follows FAIR principles by ensuring that suitable research outputs are findable through structured metadata and persistent identifiers, accessible through trusted repositories where possible, interoperable through open and well-documented formats, and reusable through clear licensing, versioning and documentation. Data that may disclose sensitive information about power grid infrastructure, operational inspection workflows, geographic locations, security configurations or non-public industrial information will be subject to restricted access, anonymisation, aggregation or replacement with synthetic data before publication.
dmp.ethical_issues_description: No ethical issues related to human participants are expected for this dataset. However, legal and copyright-related restrictions may affect sharing of some materials. The dataset is based on literature review, manuscript-related files, poster and presentation materials. Full-text third-party publications, publisher-formatted article versions, reviewer comments and manuscript files subject to peer-review or publisher copyright restrictions will not be openly redistributed unless this is permitted by licence or publisher policy. Open sharing will be limited to original project materials, metadata, allowed manuscript versions and supporting documentation.
